_notes: One entry per speaker. The key (for example 'james') is what dialogue lines use in their 'speaker' field.
display_name: the name shown above the text.
name_color: colour of that name (any hex colour).
placeholder_color: colour of the grey-box rectangle used while there is no real art.
texture: path to the real portrait image. Leave it empty until the art exists, then fill it in. No code changes needed.
Portraits always sit on the right side of the screen. The text sits on the left.

expressions: one image path per expression (neutral, worried, angry). A path here is used instead of 'texture' for that expression. Leave them empty until the art exists: the grey-box portrait then draws simple eyebrows so a change of expression can still be seen.
